cells.gaps: No fact states how the commune civil-status centres are connected or who provides and pays for the link, and none places a local government office outside Djibouti city on a connection. No total of local governments nationally is given, and nothing is held on governance or on the twelve months to the as-at.
cells.note: The three commune civil-status centres working in SIGEC at February 2024 are all in the capital, and a connection in the capital only is stage 2. Stage 3 needs an institutional connection live in local governments outside the capital, which no row states.
